name: Run Backtest Setup 2 V3

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  backtest:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"
          cache: "pip"

      - name: Cache Binance 1h archives
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: data/binance_1h_setup2_v3
          key: setup2-v3-binance-1h-${{ runner.os }}-${{ hashFiles('backtest_setup2_v3.py') }}
          restore-keys: |
            setup2-v3-binance-1h-${{ runner.os }}-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install pandas numpy requests

      - name: Compile check
        run: |
          python -m py_compile backtest_setup2_v3.py

      - name: Run Backtest Setup 2 V3
        run: |
          python backtest_setup2_v3.py

      - name: Upload backtest artifacts
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: setup2-v3-results
          path: |
            setup2_v3_trade_ledger.csv
            setup2_v3_report.txt
          if-no-files-found: warn
